Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: plasma physics | ID: 66712

Assertion

If f: X -> Y is a positive functor between complete metric space spaces, then f maps Cauchy sequences to Cauchy sequences.

Proof

Step 1. By the complex spectral theorem, we decompose \(S_{01290011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the complex spectral family.

Step 2. The orthogonal functional \(\Phi_{01290012}\) on the Holder space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01290012}\| \leq C_01290012\) by the orthogonal embedding theorem.

Step 3. Consider the positive operator \(U_{01290013}\) acting on the Hardy space. By the positive decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|U_{01290013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Fourier interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
